args.title: Freight Pricing Q1 2026 — Combined Summary (Juniper blog + subscriber companion)
args.body:
- Spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held firm; fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices (main piece: blog.juniper.example/2026/freight).
- Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least (subscriber companion: insights.juniper.example/freight/companion).
- Combined takeaway: with a soft spot market but sticky contract rates, the cheapest play is to lean on spot capacity and spread volume across ~3 carriers rather than concentrating with one.
